decisions.why: 3M tubing for Lumenis morcellator and double irrigation set with spike are general theatre consumables for surgical irrigation
UroFunnel frame and bag are drainage bag and valve systems used in urology
UroFunnel Tur (transurethral resection) pack and drape pack are endoscopy consumables for urological endoscopic procedures
SMS non-sterile surgical gown is general PPE
Tur drape is a general theatre consumable
UroPro stone catcher is stone retrieval and access equipment for endourology
